note: After Sjöstedt 1925; the original is in German; the ratio of head length to head width recorded there as 60—63:33 does not agree with the head width of 2 mm and head with mandibles 5.75—6 mm given in the same place, and is suspected to be a typesetting or extraction omission; the figures have not been altered and are reproduced as in the original. Type locality Madagascar (collected by Sikora); type specimens in the Stockholm Museum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head elongate, almost twice as long as wide (original: 60—63:33); antennal segment 3 nearly equal in length to segment 2; mandibles with extremely minute teeth. Measurements (mm): head width 2; head length (with mandibles) 5.75—6.
